detail: December 10 and 18 actions have explicit demands but no defensible numeric attendee counts. The two same-date December 10 groups are not merged because the article says their relationship is unknown.

The Dec18 BioBio article and Dec19 Aton/24Horas article describe central Santiago activity on the same date. Their locations overlap broadly, but identity and overlap remain unknown; police-reported arrests are not turnout.

Cooperativa’s 8-Jan-2021 report describes another Santiago protest with similar release/resignation demands, but no shared organizers or direct link to the Dec10/Dec18 events is established. It is outside December and is not coded as continuity.
